thread:
Sophie: quick sync — AWS marketplace + partner iac labs handoff. need a short checklist + live lab runthrough next wed. deliverables: refarch doc (1-pager + diagram), terraform module (v0.1), quickstart lab instructions, and a tiny sample app we can deploy during the workshop. goal: partners can spin up a dedicated refarch in <30m. :rocket:
Devon: sg. what's the timeline for the code + docs? can we get a prerelease branch by monday?
Kendra: i can own the refarch diagram and the workshop slides. i'll pair with devon for the terraform module testing.
Alex: i'll draft the terraform module skeleton. suggestion: keep provider blocks generic, but include an aws-specific example and a gcp note for parity. also include an "ampere" hardware note for partners using Graviton/Arm.
Sophie: perfect. scope for terraform module: module should provision VPC, subnets, autoscaling group (or EKS node group), policy for KMS integration, and an example of pinning model artifact to S3 + kms. keep variables small.
Ethan: Marketplace-Bot: checklist created -> https://internal.redwood.com/marketplace/checklists/partner-iac-lab-1977 (auto-note) :white_check_mark:
Devon: for the lab, we should include a minimal smoke-test script. something like:
```bash
# run in workshop after deploy
curl -sS https://$ALB/health | jq .status
# example call to inference endpoint
curl -sS -X POST https://$ALB/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Kendra: +1. also we need a small eval prompt set for partners to validate quality after quantization or q4_0 changes. i'll add that to the repo under `tests/` with a README.
Alex: terraform snippet for module README suggestion:
```hcl
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-iac-modules.git//refarch?ref=v0.1"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type # recommend: m6i/rtx for small tests, ampere for cost testing
  enable_kms = true
}
```
Sophie: key open Qs: (1) who signs off the marketplace listing docs? (2) do we need legal review for sample AMIs? (3) live demo account for partner SI — who manages creds?
Ethan: Marketplace-Bot: FYI — marketplace listing requires 3 artifacts: (a) architecture diagram, (b) terraform sample, (c) customer-facing quickstart PDF. legal/trademark flagged are separate.
Kendra: i can review (1) + (c) with marketing. legal review we should loop in next thursday.
Devon: creds for the live demo — ops can spin a tenant in our staging org, but we need owner. @Alex can you be demo-owner for the workshop? you'll need access to the staging org service account.
Alex: i can. please add me to the staging org and grant terraform-sa role.
Sophie: action items:
- Alex: open PR for tf module skeleton by monday (assign to devon + kendra for review)
- Kendra: architecture diagram + quickstart PDF draft by tues
- Devon: smoke-test scripts + sample eval prompts by tues
- Sophie: coordinate legal + marketing kickoff (thurs) and confirm workshop date/time with partner (next wed tentative)
- Ethan: post checklist link in partner onboarding doc and create a short runbook for ops creds
Please ack on this thread if you're good with owners and dates. :eyes:
Devon: ack.
Kendra: ack, will ping marketing and legal.
Alex: ack, starting PR now.
Ethan: Marketplace-Bot: reminder scheduled -> workshop invite draft posted in calendar (#partners)
Sophie: thanks team — i'll post an updated agenda + minute-by-minute runthrough once PRs land. :thumbsup:
